grammar.title: 与 call 有关的短语动词
lines: call on sb. 拜访，探望 Have you called on George recently? I called on George yesterday.
call (sb.) up 给某人打电话（美语） If you want my help, just call up. She will call you up tomorrow.
call at +地点 对（某个人家或地方）进行短暂访问 He calls at every house in the street once a month. He was asked to call at the station.
call out 大声叫喊 Some people on the bank called out to the man in the boat. He called out to me but I did not hear him .
call off 取消（某项活动） For some reason, they have called off the party/the meeting. It began to rain so we called off the match.
call in 召集 Call in an architect or engineer to oversee the work. 找一名建筑师或工程师来监督这项工程。 We had to call in a plumber to unblock the drain.我们只得叫个管子工来疏通下水道。

exercises.q: It's too late to go to the pictures. Why don't we call the whole thing ___ ?
I called ___ you five times yesterday. Were you out?
We called ___ to him but he could not hear Us.
I called ___ the post office on my way to work.
